title: From Sunwell to Dawnwell
summary: The Void invasion of Quel'Thalas, the Sunwell's transformation into the Darkwell, and the elven coalition's response form an ongoing modern arc.
opening: The Sunwell had been restored before, but its latest defense drew old divisions and new allies toward a crisis that changed the well again.

chapters.title: The invasion of Quel'Thalas
chapters.body: The Void entered Quel’Thalas, drawing defenders with different allegiances toward the Sunwell. Old divisions stood beside the urgent need to preserve it.

chapters.title: The Darkwell
chapters.body: Xal’atath turned the Sunwell into the Darkwell. Alleria and Turalyon disappeared there, leaving their ultimate fates unresolved at that moment.

chapters.title: An uneasy coalition
chapters.body: An uneasy elven coalition answered the crisis. Its shared danger did not erase the different histories its peoples carried.

chapters.title: The Dawnwell
chapters.body: The Dawnwell’s restoration closed one chapter of the struggle. Beyond it, the Worldsoul’s unfolding history remained open.
